title: Women's Group Backyard Gathering, 1964 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot dated September 1964 showing a large group of women posed together in a suburban backyard. In the foreground, a woman sits on the grass next to a small dachshund. Behind the group is a mid-century home with an attached garage, a outdoor clothesline, and a local municipal water tower rising above the roofline.
